summary: Arvin and Lucia stand on the edge of the mobile launchpad as the sun dips below the horizon, casting long, distorted shadows across the cracked salt. Arvin uses a heavy iron wrench to tighten a bolt on the rocket's stabilizers while Lucia holds a high-intensity flashlight steady, her gaze lingering on the corporate logo on his old flight jacket.
settingText: The skeletal frame of the junk-built rocket on its trailer.

dialogueInline.text: The higher we send this thing, the harder Cyrus will hit us.

SUBTEXT — Mutual distrust is masked by the physical necessity of the task at hand.
CAMERA / PERFORMANCE — Capture the glint of the flashlight in Lucia's pupils as she looks at Arvin.
CONTINUITY — The long shadows stretching across the salt flats.

summary: Cyrus steps out of his sleek, matte-black interceptor vehicle, his heavy tactical boots crunching on the dry scrub as he surveys the horizon through a thermal scanner. He reaches down to pick up a discarded, heat-warped circuit board from the sand, his thumb rubbing the scorched plastic as he looks toward the distant mountains where a faint trail of smoke rises.
settingText: A high-tech pursuit vehicle parked on a lonely desert ridge.

dialogueInline.text: They are building toys in a graveyard and calling it a revolution.

summary: Arvin and Milo strain against the weight of the makeshift rocket, physically pushing the heavy steel cradle into the mouth of a limestone cave for concealment. The metal rollers groan under the massive weight, and Arvin's boots slip on the loose gravel as he leans his entire body weight against the frame, his face turning a deep shade of red.
settingText: The dark, jagged mouth of a natural limestone cavern.

dialogueInline.text: Push until the sun hides us, or we're just targets for the satellites.
